summary.name: Krita
summary.one_liner: Krita is a free and open source professional painting program for digital painting and illustration, made by artists and licensed under the GNU GPL.
use_cases: using free art tools on a budget
summary.what_it_does: Krita is described as a professional, free and open source painting program made by artists. It offers multiple brush types, layers, drawing assistants and stabilizers, and animation tools. The page also mentions downloadable brushes, patterns, vector libraries, texture packs, page templates, and plugins. An online community lets users share artwork, ask questions, and give feedback to developers. It is licensed under the GNU GPL and owned by its contributors.
notable: Free and open source under GNU GPL, owned by its contributors
Multiple brush types, layers, drawing assistants and stabilizers
Animation tools and plugins for added functionality
caveats: Platforms are not named on this page; the awesome-mac listing suggests macOS but the page itself does not confirm it
Development fund is optional donation, not required for use
